description: The bar chart, titled "Average Performance," compares the average performance of five different methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClinGS (w/), and ClinGS. The horizontal axis lists these five methods as categorical labels, while the vertical axis represents average performance, scaled linearly from 0 to 60 with major tick marks at intervals of 10. Each method is represented by a single, solid-colored bar. The performance values are approximately: Standard at 55, Self-RAG at 56, FactTune at 54, ClinGS (w/) at 55, and ClinGS at 60. The bars are arranged from left to right in the order listed on the x-axis, with the ClinGS method showing the highest performance, followed by Self-RAG, Standard, ClinGS (w/), and FactTune. The bars are colored orange, olive green, lime green, light blue, and dark blue, respectively.
